title: Upgrade registry
description: Naive's versions, the migrations between them, and each package's version and channel (schema/upgrades.json, EE-076). naive upgrade reads it from the installed copy. A migration rewrites a venture's records when the framework or one package changes, like a Next.js codemod; a version's guide is bundled in docs/upgrades/.

guide.description: The upgrade guide for this version, a repository path, or null for the first version

migrations.description: Framework migrations that move a venture onto this version, in order

module.description: A module exporting id, describe and apply(dir, ctx)

package.description: The package whose schema changed, or null for a framework migration

from.description: A package migration: the oldest package version it upgrades

to.description: A package migration: the package version it upgrades to

aliases.description: The route aliases file that keeps the old routes working
